page_title: LEI 2-2 BHA | Leicester v Brighton 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Stuart Attwell has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
90+6' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) will take the free kick.
90+5' Stuart Attwell blows for a foul after Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Leicester.

90+5' A nice pass finds Danny Welbeck (Brighton) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the top of the net, but Mads Hermansen pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
90+1' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Jamie Vardy picks out Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 2:2.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Igor (Brighton) will replace Kaoru Mitoma.

89' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
88' Brighton are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) was quite harsh and Stuart Attwell didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' 1 - 2 Jamie Vardy (Leicester) meets a perfect cross from Bobby De Cordova-Reid deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.

85' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
81' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to substitute Bilal El Khannouss and he is replaced by Patson Daka (Leicester).
81' The substitution is prepared. Wout Faes (Leicester) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jannik Vestergaard.

79' 0 - 2 An amazing individual effort from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 0:2. Mads Hermansen was helpless.
78' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
74' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Mats Wieffer (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
71' Today's match ends for Yasin Ayari who will be replaced by Matt O'Riley (Brighton).
70' Substitution. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) has come on for Evan Ferguson.
70' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Joao Pedro is replaced by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton).

70' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Bart Verbruggen makes a comfortable save.
68' The cross into the penalty area from Georginio Rutter (Brighton) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
67' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
65' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
62' Here is a change. Kasey McAteer is going off and Ruud van Nistelrooy gives the last tactical orders to Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester).
62' Here's the change. Jordan Ayew leaves the pitch and Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) comes on as a substitute.
56' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
56' Joao Pedro (Brighton) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Brighton.
54' The resulting set piece from Leicester is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
52' Wilfred Ndidi is being substituted because of an injury. Ruud van Nistelrooy sends Oliver Skipp (Leicester) on the pitch.
50' The game is interrupted now, Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
49' Leicester failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
48' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabian Hurzeler decided to make a change. Carlos Baleba is replaced by Mats Wieffer (Brighton).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' A corner kick by Leicester is thwarted by the well prepared Bart Verbruggen (Brighton).
45+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Victor Kristiansen (Leicester). The linesman points to the corner flag, Leicester are going to take it.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

44' James Justin (Leicester) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the left side of the goal, but it lacks power and Bart Verbruggen pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
40' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Stuart Attwell had an easy-decision to make.
40' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
39' The free kick from long range, taken by Leicester, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Leicester have been awarded a free kick.

37' 0 - 1 A good lofted pass from Pervis Estupinan finds Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up in the top left corner. The score is now 0:1.

36' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
33' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
32' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Jordan Ayew (Leicester) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Brighton earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
32' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Mads Hermansen to dive and make a save.
30' The referee blows his whistle as Jordan Ayew (Leicester) was too aggressive in his challenge. Brighton get a free kick.
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
24' Brighton fail to score from a corner as Mads Hermansen (Leicester) leaps to collect the ball.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
20' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

20' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the top right corner, but Mads Hermansen is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Now Brighton have a corner.
16' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Mads Hermansen is equal to it and makes an easy save.
16' The corner from Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) is hurriedly cleared.
15' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Leicester are awarded a corner kick.

14' Joao Pedro (Brighton) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
12' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.

11' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Lewis Dunk (Brighton), who plants a header just wide of the left post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
11' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stuart Attwell signals. It's a free kick to Brighton in a dangerous position.

10' James Justin (Leicester) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.

8' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement. Leicester have a free kick from a promising distance.
6' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
6' A lofted cross from Georginio Rutter (Brighton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
4' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
